title: Presets
subtitle: Save a whole loadout — swaps, palette, custom decal and map — and switch to it in one click: everything else is restored first. Share it with a code.

capture.title: Save the current setup
capture.description: Active swaps, palette, custom decal and map are stored in a new preset.

empty.title: No preset yet
empty.description: Set up your car, then save it here to switch back to it anytime.

card.closeGame: Close the game to apply a preset

share.title: Share “{{name}}”
share.description: Anyone with ALXS-RL-Mod can import this code.
share.note: The code contains item ids and your palette colours. Maps are local files: the receiver keeps their own.

import.title: Import a preset
import.description: Paste a code starting with ALXS1:
import.invalid: This doesn't look like an ALXS-RL-Mod code.

random.title: Random loadout
random.description: Pick the slots to shuffle. Decals always fit the car that will be displayed.
random.hint: Uses the items you last swapped from as your equipped items.

report.description: Each part is applied on its own — here is what happened.

toast.applied: “{{name}}” applied — restart the game to see it

edit.title: Edit preset
edit.description: Rename it or remove parts. To change an item, apply the preset, edit your swaps, then save the current setup into it.
edit.fromCurrentHint: Keeps the name; swaps, palette, decal and map become what is applied now
edit.workflow: Tip: the active mods panel offers “Save the current setup into this preset” as soon as you change an applied preset.
